What's your warranty policy on defective items?

Every residential purchase comes with a free 3-Year Limited Warranty that covers defects in materials and workmanship, as long as the product was installed according to the instructions. This includes things like broken brackets, cord locks, tilter mechanisms, fabric tears, warped slats, and products that won't raise or lower properly.

If a defect is found, SelectBlinds will either repair or replace the product at no charge, and the replacement ships to you via standard ground. After 3 years, parts may still be replaced at manufacturer's cost based on availability, but fabric and slats are considered wearable items and aren't covered beyond the warranty period.

To file a claim, you'll need your order number, the affected product, a description of the issue, and supporting documentation like photos or a video. You can start your claim here.
